_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
O wewe mchezaji {player_id} na Tic Tac Toe.
Koló ya kuwina ikuwa ya kuwina mitatu mfululizo (mbala-mbala, tadi-tadi, to kimpito) na mbala.
Kwa kudia, o wewe ufwaninisa kuweka nambari ya mraba (0-8) wewe unataka kuweka chapa yako ndambu.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' kuweka chapa yako na katikati ya mbala.
Kama mchezaji {player_id}, wewe uwe '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako uwe '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kisalu ya bo mepesa beto kele ve na mutindu mosi yina mefwana.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} kele ve na kati ya baselile yina ke simbama. Yo fwete vanda 0 tii 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Na kati ya baselile {cell}, kele ti muntu mosi.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} kuweka chapa yake ({symbol}) na seli {cell}.
